notes: The circuit image shows the boards wired directly with the two 4.7 kΩ pull-ups drawn as free resistors. I modelled the pull-ups and the shared SDA/SCL/3V3 nodes on one mini breadboard (bb1) using jumper wires. The manual lists two mini breadboards, but the image doesn't show how the second one is used, so I left it out.
SDA is on A4 and SCL on A5 for both boards, as the manual states. A4 goes to A4 and A5 goes to A5.
Both pull-ups go to the 3.3 V pin of the reader board, labelled '3V' in the image. The Nano 33 IoT is 3.3 V logic and not 5 V tolerant, so 3V3 is the correct supply.
GND goes directly between the two boards by one jumper wire.
Both boards are powered and programmed over USB from the computer. The computer is not modelled as a part, so the USB cables have only the board-side edge.
The built-in LED of the reader board is not a separate part. The 3V3 pin of the writer is not connected.
